en: Vintage illustrated postcard showing a large multi‑winged institutional building with a chapel and bell tower on the right, set behind a fenced garden and tree‑lined street. The facade has three stories, gabled central sections, and numerous windows. Below the image is printed red text with the place name and a Hungarian caption about the institution, and the lower portion is filled with handwritten Hungarian correspondence. The reverse side has the heading 'LEVELEZŐ-LAP', address lines written in Hungarian, postal cancellations and a stamp from the Austro‑Hungarian period.
